# Concrete Rodeo — Full Reference

> Concrete Rodeo is downtown Bryan's neon honky-tonk and country dance hall, in the former 3rd Floor Cantina at 201 W 26th Street, Bryan, Texas. Live bands, late DJs, two-step lessons, College Night, and a full bar. 21 and up after 9 PM.

## About
Concrete Rodeo opened December 5, 2025 in Historic Downtown Bryan, Texas, taking over the room that was the 3rd Floor Cantina and turning it into a real country dance hall. It is part dive, part dance hall: a big wood floor built for two-stepping and line dancing, speakers pointed at the crowd, live bands and DJs most nights, a patio for the in-between, and a full bar with no menu to memorize. No velvet rope, no attitude.

It is owned by Dustin Batson, a Marine Corps veteran and downtown Bryan bar owner whose other venues include West End Elixir Company and Word of Mouth Speakeasy. His former bars Citrus and Salt and Vice Downtown Bryan have closed; Final Score, open at 121 N Main Street, replaces them.

## Location and getting there
- Address: 201 W 26th St, Bryan, TX 77803
- Neighborhood: Historic Downtown Bryan, Texas (a designated Texas Cultural District)
- The building previously housed the 3rd Floor Cantina
- About ten minutes by car from the Texas A&M campus and Kyle Field
- Parking: free street parking around downtown Bryan after 6 PM, plus a lot out back; rideshare drop-off is out front on 26th Street

## Hours
Hours follow the current lineup. Check @concrete_rodeo_ on Instagram for tonight's details.

## Drinks and food
- Full bar: beer, well drinks, whiskey, margaritas, and more. No printed menu, just tell the bartender what you're drinking.
- No full kitchen or food menu. Food trucks may set up out back on busy nights (announced on Instagram).

## Age policy
21 and up after 9 PM, valid ID required, carded at the door. Earlier in the evening can run more relaxed; message the venue if bringing a younger crowd.

## Events and recurring nights
- College Night (weekly): show a valid college ID for no cover and $1 well drinks all night. 21 and up after 9 PM. The night it runs each week is posted on Instagram.
- Live bands on the dance floor most weekends. Cover varies and is posted at the door and on Instagram.
- DJ nights: country-to-club crossover, late.
- Two-step lessons: beginner lessons before the band; bring a partner or find one here.
- Watch parties: big games up on the screens.
- Private events: birthdays, work parties, full buyouts by request via email.

The full dated lineup, this week's bands, and last-minute shows are posted on Instagram (@concrete_rodeo_).

## Frequently asked questions

Q: How old do I have to be to get into Concrete Rodeo?
A: After 9 PM it is 21 and up with a valid ID, no exceptions. The door cards everyone. Earlier in the evening can be more relaxed; message on Instagram if bringing a younger crowd.

Q: Is there a cover charge?
A: Most nights are free to get in. Some headliner shows and DJ nights run a cover, always posted at the door and on Instagram. Cash and card both work.

Q: What is College Night?
A: A weekly deal: a valid college ID gets you no cover and $1 well drinks all night. 21 and up after 9 PM. The night it runs is posted on Instagram.

Q: What is the dress code?
A: Come as you are, boots or sneakers. No offensive graphics, no full-face coverings at the door, shirts and shoes stay on. Theme nights encouraged.

Q: Where do I park?
A: Free street parking around downtown Bryan after 6 PM, plus a lot out back. Rideshare drop-off is out front on 26th Street.

Q: Is Concrete Rodeo accessible?
A: It is in a historic downtown Bryan building. For specific accessibility needs, message on Instagram before coming and the staff will explain what to expect.

Q: Do you take reservations?
A: The bar and dance floor are first-come, first-served. For big groups or a reserved area, email the venue.

Q: Can I book it for a private event?
A: Yes. Birthdays, work parties, and full buyouts. Email concreterodeobryan@gmail.com with a date and headcount.

Q: Is there food?
A: No full menu. Food trucks may set up out back on busy nights (announced on Instagram).

Q: Do you have a patio? Is it dog-friendly?
A: Yes, there is a patio. Patio and pet policies shift with the season and the night, so check Instagram before bringing a pup.
